literal.prompt: Какая российская станция дала название крупному подлёдному озеру?

literalGroups.primaryGround: HOLD. The question’s key relation—Russian Vostok Station giving its name to the large subglacial lake—and uniqueness among the four station choices needs a complete primary passage. The attempted NSF page did not expose its linked report body; the one official alternative returned 403. Search snippets and the old Britannica source metadata are not promoted as evidence. Retained USAP/IPEV/COMNAP sources establish context for the distractors and Vostok’s setting, but not the station-lake relation.
literalGroups.locator: No usable complete lake/station source: attempted NSF https://www.nsf.gov/about/history/nsf0050/pdf/arctic.pdf (open returned generic NSF History page; find Vostok Station returned no match); official NSF alternative https://nsf-gov-resources.nsf.gov/files/antpanel.pdf?VersionId=GqPFPoZNZli717J8M1kdIlvt_3bLkokb returned 403. Saved USAP L104 covers other station locations; COMNAP L73 covers Vostok as a high-plateau station, not the lake relation.
